insight.headline: Higgsfield concepts hit 6.2% engagement at S$166 per asset — a fifth of the agency baseline

insight.headline: Over half the 4% EPL reach gap is late content, so S$26K — not S$48K — closes it
insight.detail: Overlaying the Monday calendar's 9 slipped EPL assets on Salesforce's reach curve shows 2.1 of the 4 missing points vanish when Wunderfolk's films land Aug 21, leaving only a 1.9-point paid shortfall against SAP's S$48K headroom. Salesforce sees a gap, SAP sees budget and Monday sees delays — only joining all three proves half the top-up would pay for a content problem.
insight.action: Approve a S$26K IG and TikTok top-up at the 12:30 and hold S$22K until the Wunderfolk films deliver.
